tables.units: percent of inter-ocular distance (IOD) in image
tables.notes: Design choices consistent with blender/blender-face-addons.md Table 6; Huber delta = 2 sigma; a user pin replaces auto pins within ~3% IOD.

tables.name: focal_observability_single_view
tables.units: camera-to-nose distance m; sigma of log focal (fraction); nose-width error mm
tables.population: derived; assumes nose-tip-to-ear depth d = 0.10 m, face 800 px wide, pin noise 2 px, ~4 independent pins, nose width 35 mm
tables.notes: Order-of-magnitude derivation: sigma_log_f ~ sigma_px / ((W/2)(d/Z) sqrt(N)); realistic adds ~4% for unknown facial depth without a profile view. Shape error ~ eps*(d/Z)*feature_size. Focal error is self-limiting: observable where it matters (close range), unobservable where it barely matters (>= 2 m).
